messages:
Samir: Heads up50am: I left a note on the fridge 
"DO NOT MERGE: brunch-experiments" and now the cereal is in a feature branch. :face_with_monocle:
Jules: Please don't put unstable food on main. We had a production incident last week when someone merged `pancake:hotfix` straight to main and pancakes started serving without syrup.
Asha: Repro from the logs (the toaster speaks YAML):
```yaml
breakfast:
  items:
    - name: waffles
      version: 0.1.0-alpha
      toppings:
        syrup: "maple
        butter: true
```
Samir: That stray quote makes the toaster throw: "unexpected EOF while parsing toppings" 
which is code for "I quit."
build-bot: CI note: breakfast-lint failed on commit `cafebabe` - missing semver on jam. See https://ci/kitchen/578 :robot_face:
Jules: Proposal: adopt Conventional Breakfasting. commit messages should start with `fix(toast):`, `feat(syrup):`, or `docs(menuchoice):`. Bonus points for a changelog emoji.
Asha: Also maybe stop tagging everything `latest`. I pulled `latest` coffee and got two different roast levels, one from staging. :coffee:
Samir: Poll: vote with :maple_leaf: for classic semantics or :new_moon: for YAML-accepting-toasters. I'll close at 3pm.
Jules: Also reminder: if you write a migration for condiments, please include `--rollback` and a dry-run mode. We don't want ketchup in prod without a fallback.
Asha: Funny sticker in the kitchen: "My compiler only understands punctuation" 

Samir: Whoever wrote the README for the kitchen, please add a troubleshooting section: "If your breakfast fails with 'cannot infer syrup type', try quoting your strings."
build-bot: kitchen-ops notified. Ticket #BRKFST-321 opened.
Jules: OK I'm adding `docs(brunch): semver & yaml etiquette` to the backlog. Samir, if you merge the cereal branch, include migration notes. :grimacing:
